paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between context consistency and context inconsistency under the prefix-constrained decoding Setting. The x-aixs denotes the number of tokens for the gold prefix.
model_annotation: The line plot compares BLEU scores between context consistency and context inconsistency under a prefix-constrained decoding setting, with the x-axis representing the length of the gold prefix, ranging from 0 to 20 in integer steps. The y-axis displays the BLEU score, scaled from 23 to 29. Two lines are plotted: a dashed blue line with circular markers representing "Consistency: wait-1" and a solid orange line with square markers representing "Inconsistency: wait-9". The "Consistency: wait-1" line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 24.8 at a prefix length of 0, dips to around 23.8 at length 1, then rises steadily to reach 28.2 at a prefix length of 20. The "Inconsistency: wait-9" line begins at a BLEU score of approximately 25.2 at length 0, fluctuates between 25.0 and 26.2 across the prefix lengths, and ends at a BLEU score of about 26.1 at length 20. Both lines show a general upward trend, with the "Consistency" line consistently achieving higher BLEU scores than the "Inconsistency" line across most of the prefix length range.
